# Onward Injury Law

> Top-rated personal injury law firm in Bloomington, Illinois, specializing in accident claims, mass torts, and catastrophic injuries with 24/7 free consultations.

Onward Injury Law is an award-winning firm led by Josh Rohrscheib serving Central Illinois, including McLean County, Bloomington, Normal, and Decatur. The firm handles vehicle accidents, premises liability, product liability, and mass tort litigation with a commitment to client advocacy and recovery.
